name: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: Chilled Minced Beef, spaghetti, canned tomatoes, onion, garlic, olive oil, salt, pepper, basil
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté finely chopped onion and minced garlic until translucent. Add the minced beef and brown it, breaking up any lumps. Stir in canned tomatoes, season with salt, pepper, and basil, then simmer for 20‑30 minutes. Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package instructions. Drain the spaghetti and combine with the Bolognese sauce before serving.

name: Beef Tacos
ingredients: Chilled Minced Beef, taco shells, onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin, lettuce, cheddar cheese, salsa
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat and add a little oil. Sauté chopped onion and minced garlic until softened. Add the minced beef, chili powder, and cumin; cook until beef is fully browned. Warm taco shells according to package instructions. Fill each shell with the seasoned beef, then top with shredded lettuce, grated cheddar, and salsa.

name: Beef Chili
ingredients: Chilled Minced Beef, kidney beans, canned tomatoes, onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin, paprika, olive oil, salt, pepper
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot and sauté chopped onion and minced garlic until fragrant. Add the minced beef and brown it, breaking up clumps. Stir in chili powder, cumin, and paprika; cook for 1 minute. Add canned tomatoes, kidney beans, and a splash of water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30‑40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld. Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.
